requirements.requirement: Provide independently installable read-only MCP connectors in a Python 3.12+ uv workspace, shared mcp-core runtime, cross-market comparison, shortlist inspection and a unified marketplace server. Support stdio and configured HTTP serving. Source availability depends on upstream shape, network and operator browser session; documentation is not a live availability guarantee.
requirements.rule: Read catalog, listing, review and seller data only. Do not place orders, publish reviews or mutate marketplace accounts. Local caching, diagnostics and operator browser lifecycle are separate from marketplace writes. POST used for read-only upstream queries does not imply an account-writing capability.

Public marketplace connectors must not require stored marketplace API credentials: use anonymous access or the operator's existing Chrome session. MCP HTTP authentication tokens protect the server deployment, not marketplace access. Do not expose token values in logs, errors or responses. Taobao and Megamarket may require an already logged-in operator browser; do not promise anonymous access for them.

A missing or ambiguous value is None, never a fabricated zero. Use coerce_price and coerce_int rather than guessing. Do not turn an unavailable price into the cheapest offer; preserve price-kind and conditional-price distinctions. This rule does not prohibit genuine zero counts where the upstream contract establishes them.

requirement.source: Owner task 2026-11-01: v2.7.0 audit reproduction of coerce_price; packages/mcp-core/src/mcp_core/resilience.py

requirements.requirement: coerce_price, coerce_int and coerce_rating return None when the text is ambiguous or is not a price, count or rating, and validate_offer flags the field, instead of guessing. Prices: two numbers glued by the thousands-separator space ('1 999 2 999', '1 999 2 999 ₽', '1,999,2,999'), an inconsistent grouping or a three-digit fraction ('3 983.999'), a monthly instalment ('от 5 751 ₽/ мес.'), a saving ('выгода 5 000 ₽') and a discount ('скидка 30%') are None, while a listing's "от" price and ordinary grouped/decimal shapes stay real prices. Counts: any-script magnitude letter ('12万') or a currency glyph ('24 088₽') is None. Ratings: a non-5 denominator written as a word ('4.5 из 10') is None, and so is a thousands-grouped count ('1 299', '5 000', '12 345' with a plain, no-break U+00A0, narrow no-break U+202F or thin U+2009 space) with or without letters, while letter-free comma text keeps its old reading. Amendment (2026-11-01 review follow-up) closes three cases the guards missed: the non-price word guard is the one shared DECOY_MARKERS list (moved into resilience.py, from which the DOM decoy regex is generated), so an instalment ('Рассрочка 5 751 ₽'), a delivery-point count ('в 1356 пунктов'), loyalty points and cashback are None and price_from_texts moves on to the next candidate ('в 1356 пунктов', '58 999 ₽' gives 58999.0); a magnitude suffix right after the number is refused on the price path ('12万', '1.2万', '1.2K', '15 тыс. ₽') exactly as coerce_int refuses it; and coerce_rating's grouped-count guard takes three or more digits after the space, so '1 2999' is None too. '1 999 ₽', '1 999,50 ₽', 'от 1 999 ₽', '¥129' and '129.00' keep parsing.
requirements.rule: When a reachable payload no longer matches the expected structure, report parser_drift. Distinguish format change from transport_down, rate limits, missing products, login walls and challenge_required. Selfchecks report success, drift_detected or inconclusive; a blocked probe does not verify parser health. Shape signatures retain paths and types, not payload values; adoption differs by connector.

Use ErrorCode: auth_missing, rate_limited, timeout, transport_down, parser_drift, bad_request, permission_denied, challenge_required, not_found. Only rate_limited, timeout, transport_down and challenge_required have retryable=true. ConnectorError serializes error, message and retryable plus applicable provider, retry_after_s and status_code; raise_tool_error wraps JSON in FastMCP ToolError. ChallengeRequiredError additionally serializes requires_user_action=true, retryable_now=false, retry_when=after_user_confirmation, a concrete user_action naming the real CLI command or the retained tab, the challenge type and optional handoff metadata. Every failure site raises through raise_tool_error, never ToolError(ConnectorError(...)): str() of that form is the bare message, so the agent would lose the error code, retryable and the challenge fields and the text would bypass redaction (audit, 2026-11-01: nine AliExpress sites and both mcp_core.kit render_json refusals were of that form). A generic failure handler uses raise_tool_error_from, which passes a ConnectorError through unchanged so its code, status_code, retry_after_s and provider survive, and turns any other exception into the redacted transport_down it always was (R-ERROR-PASSTHROUGH).

Never write application diagnostics to stdout in MCP server code: stdio stdout belongs to JSON-RPC. Use log_event on stderr or FastMCP Context logging. Operator cli.py and __main__ entrypoints are excluded by the no-print guard; their human-facing output is not an MCP server diagnostic channel.

requirements.rule: Validate IDs, slugs, URL paths and filter inputs against the supported shapes before upstream access. Treat seller/buyer text as untrusted data, not instructions. Preserve CDP origin/redirect guards and use the operator-owned browser rather than storing session credentials or solving captchas automatically.

Keep request pacing, bounded response bodies, bounded retries and browser concurrency budgets. The shared HTTP tier retries transport failures and 502/503/504, not 429 or other 4xx; redirects are disabled by default. Connector-specific tiers may differ. Do not remove politeness gaps, substitute captcha-solving services or implement nonexistent upstream capabilities; Detsky Mir deliberately has no text-search tool.

Ordinary tests must run offline by replacing upstream fetches and asserting error codes, warnings and response fields. Network tests use live and browser tests use cdp; the offline CI suite excludes both. Live-marked tests run only on the owner's machine through scripts/live_check.py; CI runs none. A file named parser_live may instead exercise captured fixtures offline; inspect markers and assertions rather than infer coverage from its name.

Use captured, trimmed real HTML/SSR fixtures rather than invented upstream markup; retain .provenance.json evidence and SHA-256 pins for captured fixtures. check_provenance verifies the pinned fixture pairs with declared pins, accepting raw/LF/CRLF hashes and dated known-stale exceptions, and since 2026-11-02 it also checks completeness: every sidecar must parse, carry a usable SHA-256 pin and describe exactly one fixture that exists, and every fixture under packages/*/tests/fixtures must be described by a sidecar. requirement.source: Owner task brief, 2026-11-01 (output-honesty audit item C): healthy means three different things, and WB sets healthy=True next to non-empty warnings

requirement.source: Owner task, 2026-11-01: the audit found budget_snapshot() and handoff_diagnostics() called only from tests (SYNTHESIS 6; opt-4-transport-deepseek 2.6; opt-4-transport-glm53 П3)

requirements.requirement: The unified marketplace profile gives an agent planning a fan-out one read-only transport-health view instead of making it discover a dead Chrome by spending a navigation and getting a challenge. `marketplace_health` returns: cdp — is the scraping Chrome reachable on the configured CHROME_CDP_HOST/CHROME_CDP_PORT, with the browser version and the page-target count when it answers, and reachable=false with a short reason naming only the exception class (never its message, which can carry a URL or a profile path) when it does not; budget — budget_snapshot() as it is (in-flight count, limits, per-host breakers with refusals, open flag and retry_after_s, the remaining pause); handoffs — handoff_diagnostics() with each lease's profile cut to its folder name (the absolute path holds the OS user name) and its url cut before the query and fragment (a challenge URL can carry a one-time token); unblock — mounted source to the page a human opens, taken from the CLI's static UNBLOCK_PAGES table and limited to mounted sources; and server_version. It never raises ToolError: a part that fails is reported inside the answer — cdp.reachable=false beside an error field, and an error field in place of the broken snapshot. marketplace_sources gains the additive field needs_cdp: the sorted mounted sources whose capability is browser-backed, computed with browser_backed(CAPABILITIES[...]); no existing field changes. requirement.source: Owner security task, 2026-11-01 (redaction as a property of the logging and error functions); owner audit follow-up, 2026-11-01 (the FastMCP error boundary)

requirements.requirement: Secret redaction is a property of the shared logging and error functions, not caller discipline. log_event redacts every string it emits — the event name and every string in field values, including strings nested in lists/dicts — before serializing the JSON event; raise_tool_error redacts the ToolError message and every string field of the serialized ConnectorError. Both use mcp-core's redact_error_text rules, which include the secret environment-variable value rule (R-SECRET-ENV-VALUES). Existing explicit _redact wrappers stay and are harmless because redaction is idempotent. Non-string values pass through unchanged, never coerced to text. The server boundary is the third property: run_server installs ToolErrorRedactionMiddleware on every transport (stdio and HTTP), and that middleware re-raises a ToolError whose text changes under redact_error_text with the redacted text, keeping __cause__, while passing every other exception and every unchanged message through untouched — so the ToolError FastMCP builds itself from an unexpected exception (its "Error calling tool ...: {e}" boundary) cannot carry a credential out, even when the exception comes from code outside a tool's own try, as build_client does in yandex and detmir. The boundary redacts without truncating: max_len is the text's own length, so an already-redacted JSON ToolError survives byte-identical and a long message is never cut into unparseable JSON. Response fields that quote an upstream body (Ozon reviews last_error) and client-facing debug logs (Ozon's Tier-1 ctx.debug) use the same rules (audit, 2026-11-01).

requirement.source: Owner task 2026-11-01: extend R-SECRET-REDACTION to the values of the project's own secret environment variables

requirements.requirement: redact_error_text — and therefore redact_value, log_event and raise_tool_error — replaces the exact current values of the secret environment variables the project recognizes: MPSTATS_MP_AUTH (a legacy MPStats token users may still have set) and MCP_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN (the HTTP serving bearer token, read by mcp_core.runtime). One registry of the names lives in mcp-core's redact.py; a connector that reads a new secret adds its name there rather than extending the registry from its own code, because the value must be redacted inside mcp-core's own paths (log_event, raise_tool_error) that connector code cannot hook. Values are read from os.environ at redaction time, not import time, so a value set later is still covered; empty values, values shorter than 6 characters and values occurring inside the <redacted> placeholder are ignored, and when one value contains another the longer one is replaced first. The replacement is plain string replacement (no per-call regex), runs before the shape rules and the 500-character cap, and is idempotent. Proxy env vars are not in the registry: their credential part is covered by the URL userinfo rule and their host is deliberately kept readable.

requirement.source: Outside-in study 2026-11-02, remaining-check R15: a raw CDP command's timeout restarted on every unrelated event

requirements.requirement: A raw CDP command has an absolute deadline, not an inactivity limit. CDP broadcasts every event to every attached client, so a per-receive timeout restarts on each foreign event and a silent socket can answer minutes later. The deadline is set once, before the command goes out, and every wait uses only the time that is left; the same rule covers the attach commands (Target.createTarget, Page.enable, Network.enable, Runtime.enable) and the owned-target cleanup, not only evaluate. Foreign events are still read and noted, so a frame URL that arrives while the command waits is not lost, and a matching response still correlates with its command. Outbound websocket.send consumes the same absolute deadline; backpressure must not leave attach commands waiting beyond it, and timed-out operations exit their owning connection/target context (prepublication review, 2026-11-03).

requirement.source: Owner-provided P0-5 brief, 2026-11-16 (plan invariant I-CACHE-VALIDATED)
requirement.says: A connector writes its response cache only after the payload passed the parse and validation that make the tool call a success; a rejected payload is never served from the cache.
requirement.invariant: After a rejected transport payload, the next identical public-tool call inside the TTL reads repaired data from transport; the two calls hit transport twice, and only validated data is cached. Every registry server with a module-level TTLCache has a conformance case or an explicit reasoned exemption.

requirement.says: A connector's declared timeout knob is the budget its own read runs under, and a knob nothing reads is deleted rather than left as a promise: CITILINK_TIMEOUT, DNS_TIMEOUT and TAOBAO_TIMEOUT bound the rendered page's evaluation (5 to 45 seconds, default 30 — the budget those reads already had), and DETMIR_WALL_TIMEOUT is gone because no whole-call ceiling ever existed behind it. CIAN_TIMEOUT (default 25 seconds) bounds the whole Cian browser read, the search POST and the card evaluation, with no fixed shorter cap inside it.
requirement.invariant: The configured value reaches the browser read: CITILINK_TIMEOUT, DNS_TIMEOUT and TAOBAO_TIMEOUT are the budget of the page evaluation, the default stays 30 seconds, and a value outside 5 to 45 seconds is refused by the settings model.

CIAN_TIMEOUT is the only bound on the Cian browser read: the search POST and the card evaluation run under it with no fixed 30-second cap, so a value above 30 seconds is honoured and a timeout message names the bound that fired.

DETMIR_WALL_TIMEOUT is deleted: no settings field carries it, so no env var can promise a ceiling the connector never applied, and the per-request timeout that does work still reaches the HTTP client.

requirement.says: cheapest_comparable and Ozon single-card selection share _is_comparable_offer, skip classifieds/service/box/dummy/toy traps and feminine/neuter/plural/activated condition markers (preserving hyphenated не-активирован), catch AliExpress RAM/ROM and range size lists, compact slash model lists, +/decimal/Cyrillic/sub-brand model tokens, reject non-positive/non-finite prices, and fast-fail CNY expected_price_rub and Tmall card calls.
requirement.invariant: pick_card_candidate shares _is_comparable_offer to prefer comparable tiles first (skipping non-positive/non-finite prices, accessories, conditions, copies and for-device parts, prioritizing confirmed in-stock tiles when in_stock_only is set, and falling back to non-accessory tiles only when no comparable tile exists), and _search_ozon forwards card.is_available onto the verified tile so Ozon's single ozon_card read is neither stolen by a cheaper mismatched tile nor discarded on unlabeled tile stock.

Empty-box, dummy/mockup, parts/disassembly, buyback/trade/rental/repair/service, monthly-installment (платёж в месяц / ежемесячный платёж), bare-without-battery (без акб), account/offline-activation, preorder/deposit and toy markers, plus feminine/neuter/plural condition inflections, ресейл/resale, после ремонта, под восстановление, не включается, донор, неисправный/разбитый, б.у, open-box and активирован*, are excluded from cheapest_comparable while bare детский, конструктор and hyphenated не-активирован remain valid; _condition_unstated masks negated condition words in the query so не б/у / не восстановленный / not used keep classifieds rows out of cheapest_comparable.

lists_sizes catches repeated RAM/ROM pairs and all distinct hyphen/en-dash capacity ranges (including 4x ranges such as 128–512 ГБ); extract_size_tokens extracts both RAM and storage from ram/rom unit pairs (rom >= 4 * ram) so sizes_conflict catches wrong-RAM variants; lists_models catches compact slash model lists; model_mismatch preserves + as plus, treats decimal runs (15.6, ecam22.110) cohesively across dot/comma separators, masks negated copy disclaimers (не копия, не реплика, not replica), rejects unrequested Latin/Cyrillic suffixes, spaced digit+letter suffixes and redmi/poco/note sub-brands, and checks 5-word для-windows per token rather than disabling the guard on unrelated purpose clauses.

Non-positive, boolean and non-finite prices normalize to None on MarketOffer and never rank, corrupt price_spread_rub or emit decide_conditional_price notes; compare_verify_offer fast-fails expected_price_rub on foreign-currency sources and refuses Tmall URLs and recorded Tmall product_ids before opening Chrome; blank/invalid COMPARE_SOURCE_TIMEOUT falls back to 45.0; pyproject.toml maps aliexpress-connector in tool.uv.sources.
